subject: Procurement readiness & activation schedule — AveryTech trial
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@averytech.com>, David Lin <d.lin@averytech.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-11T15:02:00Z
Subject: Procurement readiness & activation schedule — AveryTech trial

Thanks again for taking the demo today, Elena and David — good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on procurement and billing for the trial:

What we heard from today
- Procurement preference: AveryTech would prefer to proceed on PO (not card) for production.
- Marketplace interest: team asked whether AWS Marketplace is an option for licensing to simplify procurement long-term.
- Trial success criteria (what AveryTech wants to validate):
  * Integration of inference on two production endpoints (in-app chat + background job)
  * >= 10k prompts/month during pilot OR 50k tokens/day peak
  * P50 latency < 300ms for short prompts (baseline test load)
- Billing trigger: AveryTech prefers billing to start on formal activation (post-acceptance) OR when PO is signed, whichever the customer prefers.

What Redwood can do
- We can enable a 30-day trial seat with a 200k token quota and provide a short success-kit (integration checklist + test prompts).
- If you want to keep billing paused until the PO is fully processed, we can tag the account and flip billing to start on an agreed activation date.
- AWS Marketplace is supported, but marketplace billing/approval workflows can add ~30–45 days depending on procurement.

Proposed immediate asks / next steps
1) David — can you share AveryTech's PO template (or any standard PO fields) so we can prep SOW/SaaS ordering docs?
2) Elena — confirm whether you want billing to start on (A) PO-signature, (B) activation acceptance, or (C) marketplace enablement. Our default proposal: activation date = 2026-05-01 if PO is submitted by 2026-04-25.
3) We'll send a short SOW + draft activation plan for your review by EOD tomorrow.

Attachments: Redwood-trial-plan.pdf (trial scope), Redwood-pricing-summary.xlsx

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0136
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@averytech.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Lin <d.lin@averytech.com>, procurement@averytech.com
Date: 2026-04-12T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Procurement readiness & activation schedule — AveryTech trial

Thanks Vanessa — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- Procurement preference: yes, PO is preferred for our finance team. Card is only used for low-dollar SaaS purchases.
- Marketplace: we are interested in AWS Marketplace for long-term procurement but cannot rely on it to speed up the initial trial contract — our cloud team will still need to provision and link accounts.
- Billing start: we would prefer billing to be held until the PO is fully processed and countersigned. If Redwood needs a hard activation date to flip billing, we'll aim for the activation as soon as PO is issued.
- SOW / Legal: procurement would like any SOW or ordering document to include the billing trigger clause and data handling notes (data residency: US only for now).

I've attached the PO template procurement uses. I'll loop David to coordinate the PO and timing.

Attachment: PO_template_AveryTech.pdf

Elena Morales
Head of Product | AveryTech
elena.morales@averytech.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@averytech.com>, David Lin <d.lin@averytech.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-12T16:38:00Z
Subject: Re: Procurement readiness & activation schedule — AveryTech trial

Appreciate the quick reply, Elena. Quick answers and a proposed mutual action plan: 

1) Marketplace vs PO/card
- AWS Marketplace: supported, but timeline to revenue often runs longer (30–45 days) because of marketplace enrollment and invoicing cycles. Good for long-term procurement standardization.
- PO (preferred by AveryTech): fastest path to start production billing once PO is received and processed by your finance team.
- Card: immediate but doesn't match AveryTech policy here.

2) Billing start options (we can be flexible)
- Option A (recommended for your preference): Billing starts on account activation after procurement signs the PO. Redwood can enable a billing hold and flip to active on the agreed activation date.
- Option B: Billing starts on a specified calendar date (if you want a hard start regardless of PO arrival).

3) Data residency & SOW
- We will include a short data residency clause (US-only) in the SOW.
- I attached a one-page SOW draft and a suggested activation clause. Please review and indicate any redlines.

4) Proposed timeline (to keep everyone aligned)
- 2026-04-12: Redwood sends SOW + activation clause (attached).
- 2026-04-18: AveryTech submits PO to procurement (ideally).
- 2026-05-01: Target activation date / billing start if PO processed by 04-25.

Attachment: SOW-draft-AveryTech.docx, (included previously: Redwood-trial-plan.pdf)

Elena / David — can you confirm whether procurement needs additional documents from legal (e.g., vendor W-9, certificate of insurance) so we can provide them in one bundle?

Thanks — Vanessa

Date: 2026-04-15T11:47:00Z
Subject: Internal: AveryTech procurement / billing recommendation

Internal note — tagging for ops/legal follow-up before activation:

- Recommendation: honor AveryTech's request to hold billing until PO is countersigned, and implement an account-level billing hold flag that can be flipped by ops on activation date.
- Ops needs: W-9 + COI + signed SOW (we already sent the SOW-draft — please have legal prioritize the standard ordering doc).
- Marketplace: keep as long-term option but do not route trial billing through marketplace. It complicates short-term acceptance.

Next steps (internal)
1) Legal: prepare vendor package (W-9, MSA signature block) and confirm any redlines to the SOW-draft by 2026-04-16.
2) Ops: prepare billing hold mechanism and tag the trial account. Target to be ready to flip on 2026-05-01.
3) AE: monitor PO arrival and confirm activation window with David.
